incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (General Law of Corporations), as amended, Articles 1-4 (formation), 5-9 (name and domicile), and 22-37 (directors and officers); supplemented by the Código de Comercio and regulatory norms of the Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución con Pacto Social y Estatutos (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Authorized capital may be stated in common shares of no par value or nominal value; shares may be subscribed for cash, property, or labor. Paid-in capital may be deferred until called by the board, and no escrow account is required for non-resident subscribers.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriber/shareholder hereby subscribes to the authorized capital of the Corporation as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation and accepts the allotment of ______ shares in full satisfaction of the minimum capital applicable; and RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation within Panama is fixed at [address], and the law firm [name] is confirmed as the Resident Agent; and RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed President/Secretary/Treasurer, each to hold office until the next annual meeting, with full power to manage business, open bank accounts, execute export sale contracts, and present the Corporation before regulatory authorities in connection with the Panama RUC, municipal Aviso de Operación, and sanitary registration for the pre-packaged hotpot soup base business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Object Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sede Electrónica / Departamento de Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online or in-person application for reservation of the corporate name 'Hotpot Soup Base de Panamá, S.A.' or equivalent distinctive name. Include a concise Spanish-language corporate purpose covering ISIC 4638 wholesale export distribution of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot soup base. Pay the search fee and receive the Certificado de Nombre Reservado valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passports of incorporating shareholders
Proposed corporate object/activity description in Spanish
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, file a reconsideration or amend the proposed name and re-submit; the reservation may be renewed before the public deed is executed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Panama City, followed by Registro Público de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before a Panamanian notary to execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos. Include the registered office, resident agent, board of directors, capital structure, and corporate purpose. The notary will authenticate signatures and issue protocolized notarial copies for registration.
required_dossiers: Resident agent acceptance letter signed by the law firm
Details of first directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests amendments, revise the draft deed and re-execute before a notary; no registral penalty applies if corrected prior to presentation to the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Deed with the Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the protocolized original deed and two notarial copies with the Mercantile Section. Pay the registration and stamp fees. The Registrar assigns a folio and enters the company in the corporate registry; issuance of the registered deed creates the legal personality of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fees
Settlement of applicable municipal stamp duties, if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar notes defects or issues a provisional entry, file a subsanación (curing submission) within the statutory term, pay any additional fee, and request the definitive registration; appeal to the Dirección General de Registro if rejected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply online through the DGI SICE platform using the registered deed and folio data. Complete the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) application, designate territorial taxation, and activate the corporate obligations for income tax, ITBMS and electronic invoicing. Receive provisional RUC and final fiscal registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Identification of legal representative and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI requires additional information, provide the requested documents within ten business days; administrative correction may be made through the SICE platform or at DGI service window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Book Legalization and Municipal Operation License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (for book stamping) and Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá – Commercial Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RUC issuance, present the corporate minute book, share ledger and accounting books to DGI for legalization. Then apply to the Municipality for the Aviso de Operación under the wholesale food trade activity code. Attach the RUC, registered deed, lease or title document and land-use approval. Receive the municipal operation license authorizing local business presence.
required_dossiers: Lease or title deed and Dictamen de Uso (land-use approval)
ID or passport copies of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality questions the land-use or activity code, correct the application or appeal to the municipal planning office; a provisional license may be obtained pending the final land-use resolution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección General de Empresas; sanitary registration for processed food products through Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) – Dirección General de Salud
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Aviso de Operación Comercial (Municipal) and Registro Sanitario de Alimentos Procesados (MINSA)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I – Actividades de Bajo Impacto Ambiental; requires an Informe de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental and an environmental compatibility resolution. No full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EsIA) is required for warehousing and wholesale distribution of pre-packaged food products.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Must comply with applicable Panamanian effluent limits for agri-food operations (commonly pH 6–9, BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 20 mg/L). VOCs and cooking-oil fumes must be minimized and kept below occupational exposure thresholds; solid and organic waste must be transferred through licensed waste handlers with MiAMBIENTE-compliant manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural and electrical load inspection certificate from a licensed engineer; workplace health and safety clearance from MITRADEL covering ventilation, hygiene, emergency evacuation, and occupational accident prevention for the warehouse and packaging distribution facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; official electronic portal: DGI Sede Electrónica / SISTEMA at https://www.dgi.gob.pa (RUC registration, statutory filings, e-invoice validation). Panama's legal tender is the Panamanian Balboa (PAB), at parity with the United States dollar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forms a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) before the Registro Público and appoints a resident legal agent (Agente Residente). The company then authenticates in the DGI Sede Electrónica (SISTEMA) and files the Formulario de Inscripción/Actualización del Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC), attaching the certified articles of incorporation (Ficha de la Sociedad), a notarized power of attorney, and the municipal Aviso de Operación. The DGI issues the single statutory RUC, which serves simultaneously as the income tax (ISR), ITBMS (VAT) and employer contribution taxpayer identifier. A pure foreign seller may alternatively register as a non-resident for customs/ITBMS incidents through a fiscal agent and customs broker, but that limited registration does not confer territorial-source income tax neutrality on Panamanian-source operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Panamanian law; a Sociedad Anónima is a juridical person taxed at entity level exclusively on Panama-source income (territorial principle). Available administrative elections and regimes include: (i) the DGI simplified presumptive small-taxpayer regime for micro businesses, where applicable on turnover; (ii) registration as an exporter and enrolment in the statutory automatic ITBMS credit/refund mechanism for exporters; (iii) the alternative presumptive minimum tax (Cuota Mínima) treatment applicable in certain maritime and free-zone sectors; and (iv) the irrevocable source-of-income election for specific international financial, reinsurance, logistics and transportation services. Elections must be filed on DGI-prescribed forms and bind the taxpayer for the respective fiscal period.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios; Panama's value-added/general consumption tax, governed by Articles 1057 et seq. of the Código Fiscal and administered by the DGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold in PAB/USD: any person habitually transferring movable goods or rendering taxable services in Panamanian territory must register for ITBMS from the first taxable act. Micro businesses eligible for the DGI simplified presumptive small-taxpayer regime remain subject to ITBMS registration and simplified compliance; imports of goods (including ingredients and packaging for hotpot soup base) are taxable at importation irrespective of the importer's declared turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates phased electronic invoicing ('Facturación Electrónica de Panamá') under DGI technical regulations and Resoluciones. Every sales invoice, credit/debit note and export invoice must be generated in DGI-endorsed XML format, transmitted in near real time to the SISTEMA fiscal validation service via web service/API using the taxpayer's electronic signature certificate, and carry a DGI-approved QR code / fiscal stamp before delivery to the buyer. Large taxpayers have been fully bound since the fiscal year 2022; successive DGI Resolutions have extended the mandate to the entire taxpayer population. Unvalidated documents do not support ITBMS input credits and expose the issuer to administrative fines and cancellation of the fiscal authorization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot soup base bricks qualify for ITBMS zero-rating (0%) where: the buyer is a non-resident; legal title transfers and physical custody moves outside Panamanian territory; the goods leave through an authorized customs office under an approved DUA (Declaración Única de Aduanas) in the VUPA (Ventanilla Única) electronic platform; and the exporter holds an active RUC with exporter status, enrols in the statutory automatic ITBMS refund mechanism, and files the zero-rated invoices in the periodic ITBMS returns. Services performed and consumed wholly abroad, and deliveries to the Zona Libre de Colón, receive export-equivalent treatment; documented ITBMS borne on inputs and attributable to exported units may be credited or refunded monthly under the exporters' regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Customs Declaration - Declaración Única de Aduanas (DUA) accepted in VUPA/ANA (Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas), with exit confirmation, cargo manifest and transit closure records
Transport document - negotiable sea Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or Carta de Porte evidencing physical departure from Panama and the foreign consignee destination
Financial document - Inward Remittance Certificate and SWIFT MT103/MT700 credit advice, or a bank certificate of Letter of Credit negotiation, evidencing receipt of proceeds from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and ANA audit export zero-rating at monthly settlement and within the statutory assessment window (five years, extended where fraud appears). Missing, inconsistent or falsified export dossiers cause invoices to be rescheduled as domestic taxable supplies; the resulting ITBMS is clawed back with monthly default interest, together with graduated fines (commonly 50%-200% of the tax evaded) and suspension or cancellation of the exporter's automatic refund enrolment. Knowingly false declarations additionally trigger tax-fraud penalties and customs offences against the company and its responsible directors, and may disqualify the taxpayer from future zero-rating and refund privileges. In current audit practice, the banking trail must reconcile with the DUA value and consignee identity within the 180-day repatriation window; non-reconciliation defeats the zero-rate claim and disgorges input ITBMS credited on the shipment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no issuing central bank. The monetary and financial regulatory functions are discharged by: (i) the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Superintendency of Banks of Panama, SBP), the prudential regulator and AML/CFT supervisor of banks, trusts and finance entities; (ii) Banco Nacional de Panamá, the Republic's fiscal agent and clearing agent; and (iii) the U.S. dollar as statutory legal tender, which anchors monetary policy through full dollarization without a local lender of last resort.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility on both current and capital account. Because the U.S. dollar is legal tender and the Balboa exists only as a nominal accounting unit issued in coins at a fixed 1:1 parity, Panama maintains no foreign exchange control law. Import payments for tallow, seasonings and packaging, freight and agent commissions, shareholder capital injections, intercompany loans, dividend distributions and liquidation or sale proceeds may all be freely converted, transferred and remitted without prior approval, exchange licenses, currency budgets, or economic justification filings. No SWIFT-related FX declaration forms are attached to inbound or outbound transactions. The only outflow friction is fiscal: profit distributions are subject to Panamanian dividend withholding, generally a 5% advance dividend tax on distributed profits, or 10% for certain small-taxpayer bites, and must be planned under the Territorial income tax regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender, no mandatory conversion ratio, no 180-day repatriation window, and no obligation to convert export receipts into Balboa or U.S. dollars. An exporter of pre-packaged hotpot soup base may lawfully retain USD or third-currency receivables in Panama or abroad indefinitely. The only binding obligations are AML/CFT record-keeping and transaction reports under Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015, including reporting of cash-equivalent transactions at or above USD 10,000, retention of the commercial file, and filing of foodstuff export declarations through the VUCE single window supported by the sanitary export authorization of the Ministry of Health (MINSA).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account / Capital Escrow Account (Aporte de Accionistas)
Operational USD Account with Export Trade Finance and L/C Discount Line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. After Panama's removal from the FATF grey list in October 2023, international EMIs such as Wise Business, Airwallex and Currencycloud may onboard a Panamanian S.A. using apostilled corporate documents, beneficial owner declarations and trade-flow evidence. However, an EMI is not a bank under Decreto Ley No. 9 de 26 February 1998 and is not SBP-regulated as a deposit-taking institution; balances are outside Panama's deposit guarantee regime. The S.A. should therefore use EMIs only as auxiliary rails for small buyer collections or CNY settlement, never as the primary treasury account, capital escrow vehicle, or LC clearing platform.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Panama's Law No. 23 of 2015 and the SBP regulations do not require every director to appear personally; remote onboarding is permitted where the bank applies secure e-identification, including live video verification, notarized and apostilled copies, and encrypted document transmission. In practice, Tier-1 Panamanian banks adopt a risk-based policy for a non-resident-owned S.A. and will require at least one interview of the administrator, president or authorized signatory, either physically in a Panamanian branch or via live compliance video conference. A document-only opening with no identity interview is generally available only at niche international-focus banks such as Towerbank International and remains unusual at systemically important banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity of a bearer-share legacy Panamanian Sociedad Anónima
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: File an updated shareholder register and final beneficial owner declaration under Law No. 23 of 2015 for every owner above 10% of capital or voting rights; attach a notarized and apostilled board certification showing the complete ownership chain to ultimate individuals; provide the Registro Público certificate of good standing (Paz y Salvo), the resident agent confirmation, and source-of-wealth declarations for each beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors and signatories lacking a face-to-face identity event
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certified true copies of directors' and signatories' passports with notary apostille, valid residential address proof, a banker's letter of reference from the BO's home-country bank, restricted powers of administration limited to listed counterparties, and accept a pre-arranged liveness video-call with the bank's compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-flow mismatch or third-party settlement pattern, such as export bookings while payments are routed to Chinese factories through omnibus agent accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the master framework agreement with the buyer, pro-forma and commercial invoices, letter of credit drafts, bills of lading and airway bills, warehouse photos and inventory records for the pre-packaged spicy tallow soup bricks, plus a transfer-pricing memo demonstrating the additive margin retained by the Panamanian S.A.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC and USD-correspondent screening of trade flows destined to China and Southeast Asian seaports
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the Harmonized Tariff and ISIC product dossier confirming a pre-packaged edible seasoning containing beef tallow; attach the MINSA sanitary export license, customs export declarations made through VUCE, commercial contracts stating final destination and end-users, and a negative sanctions representation confirming that vessels, banks, and counterparties are not designated entities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is injected by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home-country bank into the S.A.'s Tier-1 USD account in Panama. The remittance information field should state 'Aporte de Capital / Suscripcion de Acciones' and cite the corporate resolution approving the contribution. Panama applies no exchange-control registration, purpose-code, or prior-authorization requirement; the receiving bank verifies source of funds and screens the wire against OFAC and consolidated lists. The inflow must be booked as paid-in capital in the shareholder register, and if the aggregate paid-in amount exceeds the authorized capital stated in the public deed, a capital-increase inscription in the Registro Público de Panamá should be completed before disbursement to preserve future dividend and audit integrity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Because Panama is dollarized, outbound trade payments bypass any local FX conversion. The operative clearing rails are: (i) SWIFT MT103 and MT202 payment instructions settled through U.S. correspondent accounts over Fedwire and CHIPS, which are the true finality rails for USD; and (ii) irrevocable UCP600 commercial letters of credit, possibly confirmed and discounted by the Panamanian bank for containerized deliveries of hotpot soup base to Asia, Europe and Latin America. Each payment package must contain the beneficiary's tested KYC record, invoice and bill of lading references, the export customs declaration, and the MINSA sanitary dossier; repeated payments to freight-forwarder consolidated accounts without a goods-flow file will be deferred by the SBP-regulated bank or by the U.S. intermediary. The local ACH Panama mechanism is reserved for domestic USD clearing and is not a cross-border rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable forwards on USD/EUR and USD/GBP written bilaterally by Tier-1 Panamanian banks under ISDA terms; no SBP license or exchange-control authorization is required for the corporate end-user.

USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through New York or Miami dealer desks, because Panamanian banks do not maintain CNY balance sheets; NDF is the standard permissible instrument to hedge CNY-denominated hotpot-base buyer receivables.

USD/EUR and USD/CNH cross-currency swaps booked offshore with SBP-licensed international banks under ISDA/CSA, admissible when supported by genuine commercial exposure and an approved bank credit line.

Vanilla FX options on EUR/USD and CNH/USD acquired on a covered or collateralized basis from an offshore dealer; Panamanian law does not impose a derivatives license on corporate end-users, subject to the bank's suitability and concentration review.
